# Kathmandu Mental Health Clinic and Psychiatry Counseling Center

> Psychiatry and counselling clinic in Kathmandu, Nepal. Psychiatrists and counsellors treat depression, anxiety, OCD, sleep problems, ADHD, addiction, bipolar disorder and memory concerns for children, teenagers and adults, in person at People's Plaza (New Road) and Kalanki, or online by video for Nepalis living abroad. Languages: Nepali and English. Phone: +9779714556408.

## Key facts

- Name: Kathmandu Mental Health Clinic and Psychiatry Counseling Center (also: Kathmandu Mental Health Clinic)
- Specialty: Psychiatry, psychotherapy, counselling
- Locations: Dev Plaza, People's Plaza, New Road, Kathmandu 44600 · Kalanki Bhatbhateni, Kathmandu
- Founder: Dr. Kushal Kharel, Consultant Psychiatrist
- Hours: Saturday 5:00 AM-11:00 PM (call to confirm other days).
- Phone / WhatsApp booking: +9779714556408
- Online: all three doctors provide online consultation and therapy by video across Nepal and abroad (Nepali or English)
- Referral needed: No
- Emergency: not an emergency service. In Nepal call Police 100, Ambulance 102, or suicide prevention helpline 1166.
- Editorial standards: https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/about/

## Doctors

- [Dr. Kushal Kharel](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/doctors/dr-kushal-kharel/): Consultant Psychiatrist; MD Neuropsychiatry: KIST Medical College; MBBS: Jalalabad Medical College; CBT: Provides cognitive behavioural therapy; NMC No.: 27199 · Nepal Medical Council; Online: Online consultation and therapy
- [Dr. Sunita Lama](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/doctors/dr-sunita-lama/): Consultant Psychiatrist; MD Neuropsychiatry: Gandaki Medical College; MBBS: Jalalabad Medical College; CBT: Certified in cognitive behavioural therapy; NMC No.: 26944 · Certified by the Nepal Medical Council; Online: Online consultation and therapy
- [Dr. Bhishma K.C.](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/doctors/dr-bhishma-kc/): Consultant Psychiatrist; MD Neuropsychiatry: KIST Medical College; MBBS: Nepal Medical College; CBT: Provides cognitive behavioural therapy; NMC No.: 21985 · Nepal Medical Council; Online: Online consultation and therapy

## Services

- [Psychiatric Consultation & Medication Management](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-psychiatric-consultation): Comprehensive diagnosis, evaluation, and medical treatment planning by a certified psychiatrist.
- [Mental Health Counseling & Psychotherapy](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-counseling-psychotherapy): Individual counseling for emotional well-being, stress, life transitions, and personal growth.
- [Depression & Mood Disorder Treatment](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-depression-mood): Specialist care and therapeutic support for clinical depression, bipolar disorder, and mood swings.
- [Anxiety & Panic Attack Therapy](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-anxiety-panic): Professional care for generalized anxiety, panic attacks, social anxiety, and phobias.
- [Stress & Burnout Counseling](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-stress-burnout): Counseling designed to help professionals and students manage stress, burnout, and mental fatigue.
- [OCD & Anxiety Care](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-ocd-anxiety): Structured behavioral counseling and clinical support for obsessive-compulsive disorder and related conditions.
- [Sleep & Insomnia Management](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-sleep-insomnia): Medical and therapeutic evaluation for chronic sleep problems, insomnia, and sleep disruption.
- [De-addiction & Substance Use Counseling](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-deaddiction-substance): Professional guidance, assessment, and supportive counseling for addiction and recovery.
- [Relationship & Couples Counseling](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-relationship-couples): Therapeutic support to resolve relationship conflict, improve communication, and restore emotional connection.
- [Child & Adolescent Psychiatry](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-child-adolescent-psychiatry): Specialized mental health assessment, behavioral guidance, and counseling for children and teens.
- [Telepsychiatry & Online Mental Health Care](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-telepsychiatry): Remote psychiatric consultation and online therapy sessions for patients across Nepal.
- [Mental Health & Psychiatry / मनोचिकित्सा तथा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-mental-health-psychiatry): Assessment and treatment of mental health conditions by a psychiatrist, from first consultation to follow-up.
- [Depression & Anxiety Care / डिप्रेसन तथा चिन्ता रोग उपचार](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-depression-anxiety-care): Care for low mood, constant worry, panic attacks, overthinking, and everyday stress.
- [Sleep Disorders & Insomnia Management / अनिद्रा तथा निद्रा सम्बन्धी उपचार](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-sleep-disorders): Help for people who cannot fall asleep, wake often, or never feel rested.
- [OCD & Behavioral Therapy / ओसीडी तथा अनावश्यक विचार उपचार](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-ocd-behavioral-therapy): Treatment for obsessive thoughts and repeated checking, washing, or counting habits.
- [Child & Adolescent Mental Health / बाल तथा किशोर मानसिक स्वास्थ्य](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-child-adolescent-mental-health): Assessment and support for ADHD, autism, behaviour and attention concerns, and teenage mental health.
- [Addiction & De-addiction Counseling / लत तथा दुर्व्यसन उपचार](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-addiction-deaddiction): Non-judgemental help to cut down or quit alcohol, tobacco, and drugs, with family support where wanted.
- [Severe Mental Illness Care / गम्भीर मानसिक रोग उपचार](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-severe-mental-illness): Long-term, steady care for schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, and other serious conditions.
- [Memory & Geriatric Psychiatry / स्मरणशक्ति तथा जेष्ठ नागरिक मानसिक स्वास्थ्य](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-memory-geriatric): Evaluation of memory loss and mental health support for older adults and their families.
- [Online Consultation & Second Opinion / अनलाइन तथा दोस्रो राय परामर्श](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-online-second-opinion): Video consultation with a psychiatrist, or a fresh look at a diagnosis or treatment you already have.

## Conditions

- [Depression Treatment in Kathmandu: Signs, Types and What Helps](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/conditions/depression-treatment-kathmandu/): Depression signs, causes and treatment in Kathmandu: therapy, antidepressants, recovery and when to see a psychiatrist. Nepali or English, in person or online.
- [Bipolar Disorder Treatment in Kathmandu: Symptoms, Diagnosis and Long-Term Care](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/conditions/bipolar-disorder-treatment-kathmandu/): Bipolar disorder in Kathmandu: signs of mania and depression, how it is diagnosed, mood-stabilising treatment, family support and living well long term.
- [Schizophrenia and Psychosis in Kathmandu: Signs, Treatment and Family Support](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/conditions/schizophrenia-psychosis-treatment-kathmandu/): Schizophrenia and psychosis in Kathmandu: hearing voices, false beliefs and withdrawal, how they are treated, why early care matters and how families can help.
- [Addiction and De-addiction Treatment in Kathmandu: Alcohol, Tobacco and Drugs](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/conditions/addiction-deaddiction-treatment-kathmandu/): Alcohol, tobacco and drug addiction treatment in Kathmandu: signs of dependence, safe withdrawal, counselling, medicines and family support. Confidential care.
- [Dementia and Memory Loss in Older Adults in Kathmandu: Signs, Assessment and Support](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/conditions/dementia-memory-loss-elderly-kathmandu/): Memory loss and dementia in Kathmandu: warning signs, causes that can be treated, how it is assessed and how families can care for an older parent.
- [Autism Assessment in Kathmandu: Signs, Process and Next Steps](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/conditions/autism-assessment-kathmandu/): Autism assessment in Kathmandu: early signs in children, how a psychiatrist assesses autism, the difference from ADHD and speech delay, and support afterwards.
- [Panic Attacks and Panic Disorder in Kathmandu: Symptoms, Causes and Treatment](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/conditions/panic-attack-treatment-kathmandu/): Panic attacks in Kathmandu: what they feel like, why they happen, what to do during one, and how CBT and medicine treat panic disorder. See a psychiatrist.
- [Stress, Burnout and Exam Pressure in Kathmandu: Signs and How to Recover](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/conditions/stress-burnout-counselling-kathmandu/): Stress, burnout and exam pressure in Kathmandu: warning signs, what helps, when stress becomes anxiety or depression, and counselling from psychiatrists.

- [When to See a Child Psychologist or Child Psychiatrist in Kathmandu](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/blog/child-psychologist-kathmandu/): Signs your child or teenager may need help, the difference between a child psychologist and psychiatrist, and what a first visit involves in Kathmandu.
- [Mental Health in Nepal: Common Conditions, Stigma and Where to Get Help](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/blog/mental-health-in-nepal-guide/): A plain guide to mental health in Nepal: common conditions, stigma and "what will people say", where to get help in Kathmandu and online, and helplines.
- [मानसिक स्वास्थ्य: लक्षण, कारण र उपचार](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/blog/mansik-swasthya-lakshan-upchar/): मानसिक स्वास्थ्य भनेको के हो? डिप्रेसन, चिन्ता, ओसीडी र अनिद्राका लक्षण, कारण, उपचार र काठमाडौँमा मनोचिकित्सकसँग कहिले परामर्श गर्ने भन्ने जानकारी।
- [Can't Sleep? Insomnia Treatment and When to See a Sleep Doctor in Kathmandu](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/blog/insomnia-treatment-kathmandu/): Insomnia causes, self-help steps that work, CBT for insomnia, the risks of sleeping pills and when to see a psychiatrist or sleep specialist in Kathmandu.
- [डिप्रेसन: लक्षण, कारण र उपचार](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/blog/dipresan-lakshan-upchar/): डिप्रेसन भनेको के हो? लक्षण, कारण, औषधि र परामर्शबाट हुने उपचार, र काठमाडौँमा मनोचिकित्सकलाई कहिले भेट्ने भन्ने जानकारी।
- [चिन्ता रोग (एन्जाइटी): लक्षण, कारण र उपचार](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/blog/chinta-rog-anxiety-lakshan-upchar/): चिन्ता रोग र प्यानिक अट्याकका लक्षण: मुटु धड्कने, खुट्टा झमझम हुने, मुख सुक्ने, पिसाब बारम्बार आउने। कारण, उपचार र चिकित्सकलाई कहिले देखाउने।
- [लत तथा दुर्व्यसन: रक्सी, चुरोट र लागूपदार्थको उपचार](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/blog/lat-durbyasan-upchar/): रक्सी, धूम्रपान र लागूपदार्थको लतका लक्षण, अचानक छाड्दा हुने जोखिम, परामर्श, औषधि र परिवारको भूमिका। काठमाडौँमा गोप्य उपचार।
